title: Rooms and narrow spaces take their skylight from the world round them
summary: Rooms under a roof, wall feet and gaps between houses lose skylight; open ground is unchanged.
stage: --scenario=breach --seed=3, overcast and day, --fixed-fps 30. Room: --focus=0,-30 --zoom=8 --pitch=-62 at 5 s, roof lifted by the defenders inside. Gap between houses: --focus=7.5,-27 --zoom=4.5 --pitch=-14 at 12 s. Destruction: day, --focus=12,-31 --zoom=14 --pitch=-50 --blast-at=14,-29,3,6, 60 frames every 0.1 s.
rationale: The probes shade only skylight, a small share of daylight, so a whole-scene before/after reads as identical. Each sheet is four consecutive frames of one run (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_AB=cycle: off, on, the probe term, the bent normal), cropped tight on where probes matter, so the debug panels show what the grid contributes even where the final image changes a little. The flicker clip alternates off/on on one frame; the destruction clip pairs the game with the probe term from a second, identical fixed-fps run (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_VIEW=1).
source_ref: dines/probe-grid-gi-0571ca after 43c99b22 (the debug cycle mode, trench mask and covered-surface bounce of the following commit).
